comment: Runs of results/openrouter-2026-11-18 kept apart from manifest-entries.json for the reviewer (the chief's decision, m-10723): runs on OpenRouter's default route in which a check was answered by another upstream than the one its sample was primed on, and runs pinned to one upstream. Each has the entry it would have and a note naming the checks that crossed upstreams and their outcome. Not applied anywhere.
